Container.Name: vaultwarden-sync
Container.Overview: Nightly one-way restore of the Google Cloud Vaultwarden backups (from Google Drive) into a local standby Vaultwarden container. Downloads the newest bw_backup_*, decrypts/verifies it, snapshots current appdata to a rollback folder, restores, updates the image, and restarts Vaultwarden. Runs its own cron (SCHEDULE).

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Needed to stop/start/update the Vaultwarden container.

Config.Name: Vaultwarden appdata (live)
Config.Description: The live Vaultwarden /data folder. MUST match the data path of your Vaultwarden container.

Config.Name: Rollback snapshot
Config.Description: Safety mirror of appdata taken before each restore. MUST be outside the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Downloads / state
Config.Description: Where backups are downloaded and the .last_restored marker is kept.

Config.Name: rclone.conf
Config.Description: rclone config file containing the (read-only) Google Drive remote.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the schedule and log timestamps.

Config.Name: SCHEDULE
Config.Description: Cron expression for when to check Drive. Run a bit after your GCloud nightly backup.

Config.Name: RUN_ON_START
Config.Description: Also run one sync immediately whenever the container starts.

Config.Name: CONTAINER_NAME
Config.Description: Name of your local Vaultwarden container to control.

Config.Name: RCLONE_PATH
Config.Description: Drive folder holding the backups = BACKUP_RCLONE_DEST on GCloud.

Config.Name: BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: openssl passphrase = BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY on GCloud. Leave blank only if backups are unencrypted. KEEP AN OFFLINE COPY.

Config.Name: UPDATE_METHOD
Config.Description: How to keep Vaultwarden up to date. watchtower = pull + recreate (recommended); pull = image only; none = leave it to your own updater.

Config.Name: NTFY_URL
Config.Description: ntfy server to notify when a backup is refused for not being newer than the live vault. Blank = log only.

Config.Name: NOTIFY_HOST
Config.Description: Named first in the notification title (e.g. the host's short name).

Config.Name: RCLONE_EXTRA_FLAGS
Config.Description: Extra rclone flags, e.g. --drive-shared-with-me (usually leave blank).
